title: Descendants Wicked Wonderland Promotional Art
coreRelationships: Two large female portraits dominate the upper half, acting as primary focal points.
A fantastical landscape with a castle and oversized, whimsical elements fills the midground and foreground.
Smaller character figures are integrated into the fantastical landscape, creating a sense of narrative.
The composition is split diagonally by light and color, with warm tones on the left and cool tones on the right.
reuseFormula: Create a fantastical, character-rich collage with a strong diagonal color split. Emphasize two large character portraits at the top, a whimsical landscape with a castle, and smaller character groups. Integrate a stylized, metallic 3D title at the bottom, featuring a decorative serif for main words and a condensed sans-serif for a subtitle, with an iconic brand script.
